# cloudsmith_repository_upstream (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A descriptive name for this upstream source. A shortened version of this name will be used for tagging cached packages retrieved from this upstream.
- `namespace` (String) The Organization to which the Upstream belongs.
- `repository` (String) The Repository to which the Upstream belongs.
- `upstream_type` (String) The type of Upstream (docker, nuget, python, ...)
- `upstream_url` (String) The URL for this upstream source. This must be a fully qualified URL including any path elements required to reach the root of the repository.

### Optional

- `auth_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The X.509 Certificate (PEM encoded) to use for mTLS authentication against the upstream (Docker only). Use the file() function to read this from a file.
- `auth_certificate_key` (String, Sensitive) The Certificate private key (PEM encoded) to use for mTLS authentication against the upstream (Docker only). Use the file() function to read this from a file.
- `auth_mode` (String) The authentication mode to use when accessing this upstream.
- `auth_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret to provide with requests to upstream.
- `auth_username` (String) Username to provide with requests to upstream.
- `component` (String) (deb only) The component to fetch from the upstream.
- `distro_version` (String) (rpm only) The distribution version that packages found on this upstream will be associated with.
- `distro_versions` (Set of String) (deb only) The distribution versions that packages found on this upstream will be associated with.
- `extra_header_1` (String) The key for extra header #1 to send to upstream.
- `extra_header_2` (String) The key for extra header #2 to send to upstream.
- `extra_value_1` (String) The value for extra header #1 to send to upstream. This is stored as plaintext, and is NOT encrypted.
- `extra_value_2` (String) The value for extra header #2 to send to upstream. This is stored as plaintext, and is NOT encrypted.
- `include_sources` (Boolean) (deb/rpm only) When true, source packages will be available from this upstream.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether or not this upstream is active and ready for requests.
- `mode` (String) The mode that this upstream should operate in. Upstream sources can be used to proxy resolved packages, as well as operate in a proxy/cache or cache only mode.
- `priority` (Number) Upstream sources are selected for resolving requests by sequential order (1..n), followed by creation date.
- `trust_level` (String) The trust level for this upstream. Supported for Maven, npm, and Python upstreams.
- `upstream_distribution` (String) (deb only) The distribution to fetch from the upstream.
- `upstream_prefix` (String) (generic only) A unique prefix used to distinguish this upstream source within the repository. Requests including this prefix are routed to this upstream.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) If enabled, SSL certificates are verified when requests are made to this upstream. It's recommended to leave this enabled for all public sources to help mitigate Man-In-The-Middle (MITM) attacks. Please note this only applies to HTTPS upstreams.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the Upstream was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) The unique identifier for this Upstream.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the Upstream was updated.
